Name: Marnie's Less Ugly Ranch
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[size=5][u][b][i]Marnie's Less Ugly Ranch[/i][/b]

[/u][/size][size=3]A very simple mod with an unusually long description. [/size]

[size=3]The ONE thing that's kept me up at night about Marnie's ranch is the Yoba forsaken fireplace NEAR HAY STACKS. Seriously??? Marnie I thought you knew better! That and their rooms had [/size][u]no[/u][size=3] personality, so actually two things.[/size]

[size=3]Btw like my other mod, had to remove one of the entrance plants since I noticed a clipping issue mid-screenshot, so it's more or less accurate minus one plant. :) [/size]
[b][size=1](Also, the previews I took were in the night, so hurrah! the windows [u]work[/u] like windows.)[/size][/b]

[b][u][size=5]NEW![/size]
[/u][/b]
[size=3]Added an optional version that doesn't change the layout of the entrance and the area near the fireplace a whole lot, hopefully other mods would be more compatible with it now. Let me know if you still see some issues regarding those.

DO NOT SIT ON THE RED COUCH. Physics will not bend in a way you comprehend. You have been warned.[/size]

[color=#ff0000][size=4][u][b]Only have ONE version at a time. [/b][/u][/size][/color]
[size=3]
Cheers :)[/size]

[size=3]This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u][b]AFTER[/b][/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted![/size]

[size=4][i]Enjoy![/i][/size][size=5]

[b][color=#ff0000][i]Very Important, Read me![/i][/color][/b][/size]

[size=5]What this mod [/size][b][color=#ff0000][u][size=5][i]DOESN'T[/i][/size][/u][i] [/i][/color][/b][size=5]do:[/size]

[size=4][b]1. Gives sittable couches
[/b][/size]
[size=3]Yep, the brown couch by their fireplace isn't functional, what are you gonna do about it >:)[/size]
[size=1][b](I know there's a way to make is so they're functional, but honestly not feeling that sort of work yet, maybe in the future :p)[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]2. Edits the Heart events[/b]
[/size][size=3]
I made this mod with the VANILLA heart events in mind. So in theory, it should work fine [u]without[/u] any mods that expands on the households story, changes it's interiors, or adds any cutscenes inside their home.

[u][b]Now, in relation to that I am not sure how well this mod works with a big expansion.[/b][/u]

[/size][b][size=4]3. Give Jas parents[/size]
[/b] 
[size=3]Yep, I just typed that. No I'm not deleting it.
[/size]

[size=5][u][b][i]Compatibilities[/i][/b][/u][/size]

[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]East Scarp[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], if it adds a cutscene inside their home, you might experience some clipping issues. Otherwise should be okay![/size]
[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]RidgeSide Village[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=4]read above :)[/size]
[u][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], I'm gonna be saying no.[/size][size=4]
[b][color=#ff7700][u]Household's Story [/u][u]Expansions[/u][/color][/b], maybe, maybe not.
(Added another version that should be compatible with a few more of them though. Maybe :p)

[b]Regarding ES and RSV[/b][size=3], [/size][u]if[/u][size=3] they add cutscenes inside their home, you might get a few clipping issues/your farmer walking into some furniture. Either install No-clip or simply skip the cutscene and move on. :)[/size]
[b]Regarding their Story Expansions[/b][size=3], maaaaaybe... Try the other version and see.[/size]
[b]Regarding SVE[/b], [/size][size=3]it probably edits the ranches interior so that'll be a no, sorry![/size]
